_comment: Helplines shown on each crisis page. Scoped per crisisType  add entries here (one hazard page at a time) only after manually verifying the phone number against its official source. This file is read directly by backend/routes/helplines_routes.py on every request  no database or seed step is involved; edits take effect immediately after saving (Flask dev server picks them up on next request).

records.name: Triple Zero (000)
records.description: Call for police, fire or ambulance when life, property or the environment is in immediate danger.

records.name: VicEmergency Hotline
records.description: Current emergency warnings and incident information for Victoria.

records.name: Burn-off notification
records.description: Register a permitted burn-off so nearby residents and emergency services aren't alarmed by the smoke.
